detail: R9 (books/post-transaction-host-rely.lisp:9-75) defines fn-pth-req-data-okp and fn-pth-req-state-okp by copying the S/config-independent and state conjuncts of each fn-rtc-req-acquire/-write/-release/-close/-submit/-cancel check; the six -factors theorems and fn-pth-request-factors prove (iff (not refused) (and data-okp state-okp)). Fix: move both recognizers into the runtime contract under fn-rtc names and define each fn-rtc-req-* check from them, so the factor theorems hold by definition; then DELETE fn-pth-req-data-okp/-state-okp from post-transaction-host-rely.lisp and have OD/R0 cite the fn-rtc names. Consumer whose names this retires: P (P10 agreed 10-12). Starts after R9 lands.
title: The runtime contract's request checks fn-rtc-req-* and P's R9 recognizers fn-pth-req-data-okp/-state-okp spell the same conditions twice (kept equal only by R9's IFF factor theorems): define each fn-rtc-req-* FROM one data and one state recognizer in the contract, and delete P's copies
